description: Add Vitest as test framework and write integration tests that validate real API responses from vidapi.ru, testing response structure and data integrity
steps: Install vitest as a devDependency: run `bun add -d vitest` in apps/web/
Add test script to apps/web/package.json: add `"test": "vitest run"` to scripts section

Create vitest config in `apps/web/vitest.config.js`: import defineConfig from vitest/config, set test.include to ['src/**/*.test.{js,jsx}', 'tests/**/*.test.{js,jsx}'], set test timeout to 30000ms (since these hit real API)

Create `apps/web/tests/api.test.js` with the following test cases using Vitest's describe/it/expect: (a) Test movies/latest endpoint - fetch https://vidapi.ru/movies/latest/page-1.json, validate response has page, per_page, total, total_pages, items fields. Validate items is an array with length > 0. Validate each item has tmdb_id, imdb_id, title, year, poster_url, rating, genre, embed_url fields. (b) Test movies/trending endpoint - same structure validation. (c) Test movies/top-rated endpoint. (d) Test movies/upcoming endpoint. (e) Test tv/latest endpoint. (f) Test tv/trending endpoint. (g) Test tv/top-rated endpoint. (h) Test search endpoint with query 'fast'. (i) Test movie detail endpoint /movie/{tmdb_id}.json with a known TMDB ID from the latest response. (j) Test TV detail endpoint /tv/{tmdb_id}.json with a known TMDB ID.

IMPORTANT: Since only /movies/latest/page-1.json reliably returns 200 from this environment, structure the tests defensively. For each endpoint: if response.ok is true, validate the full structure. If response returns 404, the test should still pass but log that the endpoint was unavailable. Use a helper function like `fetchEndpoint(path)` that returns {ok: boolean, data: any} and test assertions only when ok is true. Use `it.skipIf()` or conditional expects.

Create a helper in the test file: `async function fetchAPI(endpoint)` that calls `fetch('https://vidapi.ru' + endpoint)` and returns the parsed JSON if status is 200, or null if status is 404/error. Add a 15-second timeout per fetch.

For the movie list response validation, check: typeof page === 'number', typeof total_pages === 'number', Array.isArray(items), items[0] has keys: tmdb_id, imdb_id, title, year, poster_url, rating, genre, embed_url
For movie detail response validation (when available), check: has tmdb_id, imdb_id, title, year, poster_url, rating, genre, overview, embed_url
For search response validation (when available), check: response is either an object with items array or directly an array. Each item has tmdb_id, title, poster_url
Run the tests with `bun run test` to confirm they pass
acceptance_criteria: vitest is in devDependencies of apps/web/package.json
package.json has test script that runs vitest
tests/api.test.js exists with comprehensive test cases for all endpoints
Tests validate response structure (fields, types) not just status codes
Tests handle 404 responses gracefully without failing
At minimum, the /movies/latest/page-1.json test validates full structure (this endpoint works)
bun run test passes with all tests green
bun run lint still has 0 errors
verification: Run `bun run test` in apps/web/ - all tests must pass
Run `bun run lint` in apps/web/ - must have 0 errors
Run `bun run typecheck` in apps/web/ - must pass
Run `bun run build` in apps/web/ - must succeed
